name: zoom
description: Search meetings, pull transcripts, and work with Zoom Docs.

CLIENT_ID.title: Zoom Client ID or Public Client ID
CLIENT_ID.description: A Client Secret is required along with the Client ID. A Public Client ID takes no secret; it appears after turning on Use Public Client OAuth. Copy either from your Zoom App Marketplace General app → Basic Information → App Credentials.

CLIENT_SECRET.title: Zoom Client Secret (needed with the Client ID)
CLIENT_SECRET.description: Required along with the Client ID, from the same app's App Credentials. Leave it blank only with a Public Client ID; Cursor then signs in with PKCE and no secret.
